definition: to work together on a common project
description: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.
